reviews.title: Only for businesses
reviews.text: When logging in, it gives the option for a “personal” account, but all the prompts are geared towards creators/businesses. After logging in, it says “You need a professional Instagram account to connect Instagram to Plann Login-IG. A professional account gives you access to free tools that help you grow your business or followers. Learn more”. I pressed “learn more” and the link doesn’t work… So I went to delete my account, but deletion is ‘pending’. I don’t like that I don’t have control over my own information/account.

I’m either being given incorrect information, or very generic replies. Issues are not correctly investigated or resolved. Very disappointing as it could be a great program if it worked all the time

reviews.title: Pointless
reviews.text:
I switched over from the Later App hoping to get more out of the app. Instead it’s been non-stop back and forth with a rep that ignores what my concerns are and sends me generic answers!

The app DOES NOT post unless you set it to AUTO-POST. I like to schedule my post and have them set to a ‘push notification’ so I can add music, tag everyone, adjust post settings, etc. But when I schedule a post, NOTHING HAPPENS on the phone’s end ! I just get a notification that “it’s time to post” and all it does is opens the app! Isn’t it supposed to copy the text for me or at least download the media to my phone?? Also, it is missing a POST NOW feature on the app, it’s pointless for it to be only on the online platform. So annoyed and now back to Later I go, at least I know everything works the way it’s supposed over there 😒
